# Timeline Set (T1–T5)

Comparative time-series on the `year` dimension (2010–2025; 2026 partial, dropped). Each standalone, companion finish.

> **Discipline notes:** Income-comparative ones (T1, T2) use single-country **extracted** geography with known income. T3 uses `country_universe` denominators per income group. T5 is abstract-only proxy (screening corpus, 100%), "not reported ≠ not done".

---

  <img src="../figures/fig_equity_time.png" alt="T1 Equity over time">
  <div class="figure-title">T1 — Equity Over Time</div>

<div class="figure-card">

<div class="figure-card">
  <img src="../figures/fig_reach_time.png" alt="T3 Reach over time">

<div class="figure-card">
  <img src="../figures/fig_method_stream.png" alt="T4 Method streamgraph">
  <div class="figure-title">T4 — Method Streamgraph</div>

  <div class="figure-description">Econ-eval-type composition over time (2010–2025). Stacked streamgraph.</div>
  <div class="figure-finding">**Cost-utility 45% → 54%**, cost-effectiveness **34% → 25%**. Field increasingly adopts CUA (QALY) methods; CEA declining. Mirrors C11/T2 metric shift.</div>

<div class="figure-card">
  <img src="../figures/fig_decision_time.png" alt="T5 Decision-usefulness over time">
  <div class="figure-title">T5 — Decision-Usefulness Over Time</div>

  </div>
  <div class="figure-description">Share of abstracts foregrounding each decision-analytic element by year. Abstract-only proxy (screening corpus, 100%).</div>
  <div class="figure-finding">All four rose: **threshold most (12%→29%)**, ICER (25%→48%), PSA (15%→38%), perspective (18%→42%). Reporting improving but majority still foregrounds none.</div>

---

## Timeline Summary

| Figure | Trend | Key Finding |
|--------|-------|-------------|
| **T1** | ↗ Rising | LMIC share 16→36% vs 83% burden — progress but large gap |
| **T2** | ↗ Converging | QALY gap narrowed ~10pp (15→49% vs 51→59%) |
| **T3** | ↗ Saturating | LIC country reach 28→96% (last to saturate) |
| **T4** | ↗ Shifting | CUA 45→54%, CEA 34→25% — method shift to CUA |
| **T5** | ↗ Improving | All 4 decision elements rising; threshold most (12→29%) |
